notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. Shares some passages with 'THE PENITENT THIEF' in Men of the Bible, but it opens differently (and closely resembles the opening of 'The Dying Thief' in Wondrous Love); kept as a separate entry.
